Nina: Quick thread: I'm updating the Dedicated quickstart to include an isolation example for multi-tenant customers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4780. Need a sanity check on the wording for 'soft isolation' vs 'strict isolation'.
Omar: soft = shared scheduling with label-based isolation; strict = tenant-exclusive GPUs. We should include the behavior matrix: throughput, latency variance, eligible for burst.
Eve: Add a tiny diagram? We usually avoid images in quickstart. Maybe a small table and a note about eviction behavior: "Soft isolation pools may evict lower-priority pods during bursts."
Nina: added a three-row table and an example `nodeSelector` snippet. Also added a short incantation to request eviction-safe model placement: `nodeAffinity` + `priority_class`.
docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR 4780  https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4780  status: pending
Omar: can we also reference the SLA doc where we describe latency guarantees for strict vs soft isolation? Link to /docs/sla/dedicated-capacity#isolation-behavior
Nina: linked that anchor and fixed anchor casing (was failing in preview).
Eve: LGTM. Tiny nit: replace "evict" with "preempt" in one place to match runtime terminology.
Nina: fixed, merged after CI. Will ping #customer-success.
